title: Figure 31: recirculating-beam free-electron laser (RBFEL) system schematic
description: Schematic of a recirculating-beam FEL showing an electron accelerator of cavity cells atop a central "RF Power Liquid Helium Refrigerator" block, with a beam dump and injector on either side and a red dotted electron beam loop. Below, a resonator line runs from a reflecting mirror through a green undulator to an out-coupling mirror. Captioned "Figure 31. Recirculating-Beam FEL System (courtesy of the Naval Post-Graduate School FEL Lab)," in a passage on the Navy DE&EWS program and RBFEL technical features.
